'''Ozer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] where his squad worked with a group of [[Voss commandos]] in the [[Gormak Lands]]. They were attacked by a [[Ssorokk|cyberbeast]] after approaching a cave, and all of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] and the rest of Ozer's squad were [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Ozer then encountered a Republic aligned individual who he asked to clear out the cave of cyberbeasts and recover the dog tags of his fallen comrades. The individual succeeded, and Ozer was later rescued.
